name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate

entry.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
entry.note: The AWS machine learning credential still on offer after the Machine Learning Specialty was retired in March 2026
entry.audience: ML engineers and MLOps practitioners building on AWS

reading.summary: This is a role-based certification for machine learning engineers and MLOps engineers. It validates the ability to implement machine learning workloads in production and operationalize them on AWS. Holding it shows technical ability with AWS machine learning services and can support job roles in machine learning.
reading.audience: It is for individuals with at least one year of experience in machine learning engineering or a related field and one year of hands-on experience with AWS services. The page also says professionals without prior machine learning experience can use the Exam Prep Plans to build knowledge and skills.
reading.prerequisites: At least one year of experience in machine learning engineering or a related field and one year of hands-on experience with AWS services. Professionals without prior machine learning experience can take training in the Exam Prep Plans.
